# TextLink

A link takes the colour of the module it opens, is always underlined (1px, offset 3px) and set in weight 600, so colour tells you where you will land and the u…

`SongNodes.TextLink` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.TextLink href="…">…</SongNodes.TextLink>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.TextLink" href="…">…</x-import>
```

## Props (TextLinkProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `href` * | `string` | Destination URL or route. |
| `module` | `"graph" \| "library" \| "sets" \| "paths" \| "harmony" \| "sources" \| "pipeline" \| "services"` | Module the link opens; sets the colour. Omit for the generic `link` colour. |
| `external` | `boolean` | Leaves SongNodes: adds ↗, target=_blank, rel=noopener and the hidden "opens in a new tab". |
| `onTonal` | `boolean` | Link sits inside a tonal card: uses destination ink text with the destination-hue underline. |
| `path` | `boolean` | Render as a mono path/ID that breaks anywhere. |
| `breakAnywhere` | `boolean` | Allow long URLs in prose to break anywhere. |
| `current` | `boolean` | Marks the link to the current page (aria-current="page"). |
| `children` * | `ReactNode` | Link text naming the destination. |
